summary: dellemc.openmanage known issues for 11.1.0: no SOCKS proxy export, no authenticated iDRAC8 shares, and same-named uplinks being modified.
questions: What openmanage issues are listed for Ansible 11.1.0?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (11.1.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `idrac_diagnostics`: no SOCKS proxy export to HTTP/HTTPS shares.
- `idrac_firmware`: no authenticated shares on iDRAC8.
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: a duplicate name modifies the existing uplink.
